parsed.evidence_quote: Database search were performed with MaxQuant software (Version 1.6.2.3).

parsed.instructions_note: Samples are cell lines; donor sex is not defined.

parsed.value: At least two biological replicates for each proteomic experiment; experiments are described as duplicated prox-SILAC (e.g., ER: duplicated for 4 h/8 h/12 h; ER stress: duplicated for thapsigargin and control) and multiple replicates for some conditions (e.g., mitochondrial matrix: replicated experiments at 4 h/8 h/12 h; ER stress pulse-SILAC: three replicates; neurite growth prox-SILAC: duplicated at D0/D7/D10; neurite growth pulse-SILAC: performed at D0/D7/D10).
parsed.evidence_quote: All proteomic experiments contain at least two biological replicates.
Only the proteins identified in both replicates were taken for subsequent analysis.
parsed.instructions_note: No explicit statement that biological samples were pooled prior to MS.

parsed.evidence_quote: Database search were performed with MaxQuant software (Version 1.6.2.3). The digestion mode was set to trypsin.
For SILAC medium preparation, L-arginine and L-lysine were replaced by heavy-labeled L-arginine-13C6-15N4 and heavy-labeled L-lysine-13C6-15N2.
alkylated with 20 mM iodoacetamide in the dark at 35 °C for 30 min.

parsed.value: high pH reversed-phase peptide fractionation kit

parsed.value: High-pH RP fractionation; eluted fractions were mixed pairwise (nth and n+4th) to yield 4 fractions for LC-MS/MS analysis.
